item.title: V0.1.1 Echo
item.description:
Changelog

  1. Clearer Shortcut Guidance: The welcome window now uses the same Turn Off System Screenshot Shortcuts button and step-by-step instructions as Settings, with clearer Chinese wording.
  2. Welcome Back: Open the welcome window again from Settings → About → Show Welcome Window, keeping your existing choices.

更新日志

  1. 快捷键指引更清楚：欢迎页的“关闭系统截屏快捷键…”现在会先显示与设置页相同的操作指引，中文说明也更明确。
  2. 随时重看欢迎页：在“设置 → 关于”点击“显示欢迎页”即可重新打开，已有选择会保留。

item.title: V0.1.0 Shutter
item.description:
Changelog

  1. Built on the System: Screenshots, recording, text recognition and Quick Look are the Mac's own, so selecting works and the pictures come out exactly as you already know them.
  2. Your Keys: The defaults are the system's screenshot keys ⇧⌘3, ⇧⌘4 and ⇧⌘5, Settings shows how to take them over from macOS, and every action can have a shortcut of your own.
  3. Floating Preview and Pins: Every capture lands as a card in the corner to copy, save, drag into another app, annotate, or pin above all windows.
  4. Straight to a Folder: Recordings are written into a folder you choose as they are made, screenshots can be saved there the moment they are taken, each under a name pattern of your own.
  5. Annotation: Arrows, shapes, pen, highlight, text, counters and mosaic can still be moved, reshaped, recoloured or deleted after they are drawn, and the picture zooms up to 8× for the fine parts.
  6. Scrolling Capture (Experimental): Select a region and scroll by hand while a live preview beside it shows the tall picture growing, with sticky headers, sidebars and floating bars kept out of the seams.
  7. Text Recognition: Select an area and its Chinese and English text is on the clipboard, recognised on your Mac, with table rows and terminal columns kept on one line.
  8. Recording: Record a region, a window or the whole screen as video or GIF, with microphone, system audio and a countdown, stopping by itself at a size you set.
  9. A Clean Desktop: Desktop icons can be hidden while you select and record, on every screen, and come back as soon as you are done.
  10. Light by Design: The menu bar app idles around 20 MB, because editing, GIF conversion and text recognition each run in a helper that quits when done.
  11. A Guided Start: The welcome window demonstrates a capture and brings screen recording permission, screenshot shortcuts, Open at Login and update choices together.
  12. Updates Your Way: Check for updates yourself, have Kamira check and ask before installing, or choose automatic installation, with daily, weekly or monthly checks.

更新日志

  1. 站在系统肩上：截图、录屏、文字识别和快速查看用的都是 Mac 自带的能力，框选的手感和截出来的图都和你熟悉的一样。
  2. 快捷键随你：默认就是系统截屏的 ⇧⌘3、⇧⌘4、⇧⌘5，设置里一步步教你从系统手里接过来，每个操作也都能换成你顺手的组合。
  3. 悬浮预览与贴图：每次截图都会在屏幕角落留下一张卡片，可以复制、保存、拖进别的应用、标注，或者贴在所有窗口上方。
  4. 直接存进文件夹：录屏边录边存进你指定的文件夹，截图也可以在截下的那一刻自动存进去，都按你定的规则命名。
  5. 标注：箭头、形状、画笔、高亮、文字、序号和马赛克，画完照样能移动、改形、换色或删除，细小的地方还能放大到 8 倍再下笔。
  6. 滚动长截图（实验功能）：框好区域后手动滚动，旁边的小预览实时显示长图越拼越长，固定的页眉、侧栏和悬浮工具条都不会被重复拼进去。
  7. 识别文字：框一下，中英文就进了剪贴板，全程在本机完成，表格和终端里同一行的内容取出来还在同一行。
  8. 录屏：可以录区域、窗口或整个屏幕，存成视频或 GIF，麦克风、系统声音和倒计时都能单独开关，录到你设定的大小会自动停下。
  9. 桌面清清爽爽：框选和录屏时可以先把桌面图标藏起来，每块屏幕都管用，结束后立刻恢复。
  10. 天生轻量：菜单栏常驻只占约 20 MB，标注、GIF 转换和文字识别各自在用完即退的子进程里完成。
  11. 初次见面，一起设好：欢迎页先演示怎样截图，再把录屏权限、截屏快捷键、登录时打开和更新方式放在一起，方便首次使用时逐项设置。
  12. 更新由你决定：可以自己检查更新，也可以让 Kamira 检查后询问或自动安装，检查频率可选每天、每周或每月。
